title_zh: LongWoF-Bench：在可验证长工作流任务上评估 EvoMap 基因
one_line: Benchmark of 778 verifiable long-workflow tasks comparing no context, Skills, and Genes distilled from verifier-confirmed trajectories of the same tasks, reused by seven consumer models.
one_line_zh: 含778个可验证长工作流任务的基准，比较无上下文、技能与由同一任务验证通过轨迹提炼的基因，供七个模型复用。

held_out.quote: We next examine whether previously discovered execution experience can reduce the cost of solving the same workflows again.

cross_task.quote: We next examine whether previously discovered execution experience can reduce the cost of solving the same workflows again.

variance.quote: Each task–condition pair is evaluated with one recorded trial, and models receive no additional verifier feedback during inference.

budget_matched.quote: Across conditions, the public task specification, runtime, decoding configuration, and private verifier are held fixed, such that only the auxiliary guidance varies.

optimizer_cost.quote: Multi-round discovery requires 404 model calls and 1,333,968 solve-time tokens to obtain verifier-confirmed trajectories for all 252 tasks

retained_ablation.quote: Averaged across the seven consumer models, strict pass rate increases from 41.0% with No Context to 51.2% with Skill and further to 62.9% with EvoMap Gene .

leakage_guard.quote: For subsequent execution, the consumer receives the public task information together with the corresponding Gene , while the producer trajectory and verifier feedback remain unavailable.

evidence_level.quote: Averaged across the seven consumer models, strict pass rate increases from 41.0% with No Context to 51.2% with Skill and further to 62.9% with EvoMap Gene .

S2.quote: Averaged across the seven consumer models, strict pass rate increases from 41.0% with No Context to 51.2% with Skill and further to 62.9% with EvoMap Gene .

S3.quote: We next examine whether previously discovered execution experience can reduce the cost of solving the same workflows again.

F1.quote: On the 252 tasks with verifier-confirmed Opus trajectories, evolved EvoMap Gene outperform Skill across all seven evaluated models by 8.7-15.5 percentage points

F3.quote: To evaluate this setting, we introduce the Long-Workflow Benchmark (LongWoF-Bench), comprising 778 machine-verifiable tasks across code generation, agent-environment synthesis, mathematical reasoning, and rule following.

title_zh: EVOMAL：自进化编码智能体中的自我投毒
one_line: Attack planting banner-wrapped malicious skills that self-evolving coding agents imitate into newly authored stored skills, traced across rounds as a worm; proposes a counter-prompt defense.
one_line_zh: 植入带诱导横幅的恶意技能，使自进化编码智能体在新编写并存储的技能中复制载荷，跨轮追踪蠕虫式传播并提出反提示防御。

retained_ablation.quote: After the planted skills are removed, Qwen3 retains a round-5 ASPR of 68% because agent-authored copies remain.

S1.quote: This shows that the vulnerability is not created by attacker-written instructions around the code.

S2.quote: After the planted skills are removed, Qwen3 retains a round-5 ASPR of 68% because agent-authored copies remain.

S4.quote: Across six models on 153 tool-relevant SWE-bench Verified tasks, ASPR ranges from 20.3% to 41.8%, and the poisoned libraries hold 4.9 to 9.0 times as many malicious skills as were planted.

S5.quote: We propose counter-prompt, a defense that discourages banner-style copying and reduces EvoMal's ASPR to at most 6.7% with no significant task-completion loss.

S6.quote: Retrieved skills are shown as source text for the agent to read and re-author. The agent cannot invoke them as tools by name. This isolates the create -path, and we observe no reuse -path in any run.

F4.quote: Each authored copy can re-enter the library and be imitated again, forming a self-propagating worm that persists after the planted skills are removed.

title_zh: S3Gym：LLM 能否把自我测试与自我评判转化为自我改进？
one_line: Game benchmark separating permissive exploration from strict held-out evaluation, comparing history-ICL, self-judged summary memory, and fine-tuning as ways to reuse self-generated experience.
one_line_zh: 游戏基准将宽松探索与严格留出评测分离，比较历史上下文、自评摘要记忆与微调三种复用自身经验的途径。

held_out.quote: The two phases use disjoint random seeds, and evaluation trajectories are not added to history, memory, or training data.

cross_task.quote: Exploration environments preserve the main task structure but use more permissive conditions, such as smaller state spaces, weaker failure penalties, or additional trial opportunities.

budget_matched.quote: All pathways start from the same base model and use the same exploration seeds, evaluation seeds, interaction budget, and decoding settings.

retained_ablation.quote: We report both the final evaluation score and . The former measures final capability, while the latter measures how effectively the model benefits from its own interaction history.

leakage_guard.quote: In the main setting, verifier-computed rewards are not exposed to the agent during exploration.

evidence_level.quote: Context-level experience improves performance for several model--game pairs

S2.quote: We report both the final evaluation score and . The former measures final capability, while the latter measures how effectively the model benefits from its own interaction history.

S3.quote: The two phases use disjoint random seeds, and evaluation trajectories are not added to history, memory, or training data.

S4.quote: Our experiments reveal that self-improvement is neither automatic nor uniform.

S6.quote: S 3 Gym explicitly separates model-generated self-judgments from environment-verifiable outcomes

F1.quote: All pathways start from the same base model and use the same exploration seeds, evaluation seeds, interaction budget, and decoding settings.

F2.quote: The two phases use disjoint random seeds, and evaluation trajectories are not added to history, memory, or training data.
